mission: Inside the breach, each person shows what unweaving does to them, and Ben comes out of it carrying two facts his body understands before his mind can explain them.
why_now: The unwoven zone strips performance off everyone in it. Each character's honest register surfaces when the Force can no longer mediate. Per D7, Torin's register here is withheld rather than exposed — his direction is not the answer the midpoint delivers; the answer is the embodied experience of full unweaving, plus two pieces of load-bearing knowledge that travel through Ben's body rather than through exposition.
conflict: Sera fights to hold discipline against the missing second blade. Kael navigates the zone with unexpected ease. Desh reports environmental data the way he always reports environmental data while grief that does not know its object lands on him. Torin's Force presence changes in the deepest part of the breach and Ben cannot read which way it changed. The withheld answer is the most pressure-loaded ambiguity in the story so far.
turning_point: Ben's body understands two things before his mind does. First: the zone's shape is anchored to a geographical specific, and the only place Veraine's ritual can complete is Veranthos. Second: the surviving anchors are drawing harder on each other than they were the last time he sensed them. Neither of these lands as a sentence; both land as felt-fact. Meanwhile, Torin stops at the worst of the breach and stands unreadable.
opening_hook: Inside the unwoven zone: the Force arrives in pieces, each voice partial. Sera's hands clench. Kael moves like someone whose feet know the ground. Torin walks toward the worst of it and does not come back for a long time
closing_hook: They leave the zone. The Weave snaps back — the relief is immediate and physical. Ben looks at Torin and cannot read what is in him. He does not know what Ben is looking for. Ben does not know what he is looking at
emotional_trajectory: Group distress differentiated by training -> Ben's body absorbing two load-bearing facts without language -> Torin's unreadable return -> held ambiguity on departure

stakes.personal: Ben's pattern-recognition pressurising without the vocabulary to name what he is reading — per D1 Trauma Lie under test, his capacity to judge whose Force-reading is trustworthy is specifically the skill the midpoint asks him to use without any of the usual instruments
stakes.interpersonal: The group has been inside full unweaving together. Something happened to Torin. No one has a name for what they saw or did not see.
stakes.external: If the wound opens fully, this is what the galaxy feels. Veranthos is the specific site. Cascade is accelerating.

setting: Breach Zone — deep inside the unwoven area, then retreat to the perimeter
sensory_details: The Force as multiple voices speaking at once, each partial — Ben assembling nothing; Sera's bilateral muscle memory meeting no reciprocal pressure and compensating every beat late; Kael's breathing steady in a place where everyone else's pattern has broken; Desh's face registering a sadness without an object, noted in his tone but not in his speech; Torin walking into the dead centre of the breach and staying there; the Weave snapping back on exit with a relief Ben feels behind his sternum; Torin's face on turning, absolutely still, absolutely unreadable
canon_elements_needed: Force wound phenomenology in full-unweaving register
Geographical anchoring of Force rituals in Legends metaphysics
action_beats: Sera's hands clench and her body braces against a pressure that does not arrive — her Force-lock training running without its reciprocal
Kael moves through the zone with the economy of someone who is finally home; his breathing does not change
Ben reaches for the Force and gets multiple partial voices, each a fraction; he stops assembling

Desh's chrono-drift readings line up in Ben's peripheral vision with what Ben's body is sensing about the zone's shape — Veranthos as the only completion site resolves as felt-fact, not as a spoken conclusion
Ben's attention registers the surviving anchors drawing harder on each other than before — a multiplicative coupling he cannot put into words, planted for later
Torin walks into the worst of it, stops, stands there a long time
Torin turns; his face is unreadable; the group absorbs the silence and steps out of the zone
notes: Stay inside the experience. Torin must remain unreadable here, and the new knowledge should arrive as sensation, not analysis.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Ben's body understands two things before his mind does: the zone's shape is anchored to a geographical specific (Veranthos as the only completion site for Veraine's ritual), and the surviving anchors are drawing harder on each other than before — a multiplicative coupling he cannot name. Simultaneously, Torin walks into the worst of the breach, stands there a long time, and returns with his Force presence unreadable.
turning_point_detail.shift: The scene pivots from differentiated group distress under Force-deprivation to Ben's embodied knowledge of tactical constraint (Veranthos) and systemic acceleration (anchor coupling). Torin's unreadable return introduces the story's central ambiguity: his direction is withheld, his intentions opaque, his allegiance uncertain. The group has survived full unweaving together, but something happened to Torin that no one can name.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben's pattern-recognition pressurizes without vocabulary — his capacity to judge whose Force-reading is trustworthy (the Trauma Lie under test) is exactly the skill the midpoint demands he use without the usual instruments. The group absorbs the silence of Torin's return and steps out of the zone carrying unspoken dread. No one has a name for what they saw or did not see.

emotional_arc.start: Group distress differentiated by training — Sera's discipline fracturing, Kael's unexpected ease, Desh's objectivity under strain, Ben's instinct pushing toward action.
emotional_arc.shift: Ben's body absorbs two load-bearing facts without language, his pattern-recognition tightening without words to contain it. The pressure of Torin's unreadable return lands as dread without object.
emotional_arc.end: Held ambiguity on departure — relief at exiting the zone immediately undercut by the impossibility of reading Torin's face. Ben braced for what he cannot name.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera's hands clench and her body braces against a pressure that does not arrive — her Force-lock training running without its reciprocal, muscle memory meeting no response.
key_beats.state_change: The opening pressure becomes concrete instead of abstract. Group distress surfaces as differentiated responses to Force-deprivation.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers Sera's compensation — the half-beat lag in her body's response — and feels the instinct to act, to fill the gap she is bracing against. His own breath tightens in sympathy.

key_beats.beat_description: Kael moves through the zone with the economy of someone who is finally home; his breathing does not change, his stride does not hesitate, his body does not compensate for missing pressure.
key_beats.state_change: Pressure escalates. Kael's unexpected ease in the unwoven zone becomes undeniable — he is not struggling the way the others are. The mission advances: Ben's focus tightens on what just changed.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's attention snags on Kael's steadiness. A question forms without words — something about the zone's shape, about who belongs where. His body registers the wrongness before his mind can articulate it.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben reaches for the Force and gets multiple partial voices, each a fraction — no coherence, no unified field, only shards. He stops assembling them.
key_beats.state_change: The Force itself becomes unreliable as a tool. Ben's usual instruments fail. He must navigate by other means.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The silence where the Force should be lands as vertigo. Ben's body tenses against the absence, then releases it — a deliberate choice to stop reaching. His sternum tightens with the effort of not grasping.

key_beats.beat_description: Desh's chrono-drift readings line up in Ben's peripheral vision with what Ben's body is sensing about the zone's shape — the geographical anchoring of the breach, the way it holds its boundaries, the single point where completion becomes possible. Veranthos. Not as a conclusion, but as a felt-fact.
key_beats.state_change: The first load-bearing knowledge resolves: the zone's shape is anchored to a geographical specific, and Veraine's ritual can only complete at Veranthos. This is not information Ben can speak yet. It is knowledge his body carries.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's breath catches. The knowledge arrives as a physical certainty — a weight settling into his chest, a direction his body understands without explanation. He does not look at Desh. He does not need to. The data and the sensation align.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben's attention registers the surviving anchors drawing harder on each other than before — a multiplicative coupling, each anchor's drain accelerating the others' depletion. The cascade is not slowing. It is feeding itself.
key_beats.state_change: The second load-bearing knowledge: the system is not merely failing, it is accelerating. The anchors are no longer independent variables. They are coupled, interdependent, pulling each other toward collapse. The timeline has compressed.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The sensation lands as a vibration in Ben's bones — a frequency he feels rather than hears. His hands clench. The knowledge arrives without language, without the possibility of language. It is pure embodied fact: the cascade is faster than anyone believed.

anti_patterns: Do not stay outside the experience — stay inside the experience.
Do not articulate Torin's state — Torin must remain unreadable here.
Do not deliver new knowledge as analysis — the new knowledge should arrive as sensation, not as a spoken conclusion.
